name: Cyber-Stein
source_text: At the cost of 5000 of your own Life Points, you can Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Fusion Deck in face-up Attack Position.
notes: Pays 5000 LP and summons a Fusion Monster from the Extra Deck.
